attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2781/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It gives no century, no desert and no year, so there is no `dates` object and no coordinate; the only sources it names are the Paradise of the Fathers and Nicodemus the Hagiorite's note on it. None of the seven Rufus folders the corpus already holds is a desert ascetic kept on this day. No hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
